source.author: ov
source.text: Se tamen horrendae clipei, quem laeva gerebat, aere repercusso formam aspexisse Medusae, dumque gravis somnus colubrasque ipsamque tenebat, eripuisse caput collo; pennisque fugacem Pegason et fratrem matris de sanguine natos addidit et longi non falsa pericula cursus, quae freta, quas terras sub se vidisset ab alto et quae iactatis tetigisset sidera pennis.
source.text_original: Se tamen horrendae clipei, quem laeva gerebat, / aere repercusso formam aspexisse Medusae, / dumque gravis somnus colubrasque ipsamque tenebat, / eripuisse caput collo; pennisque fugacem / Pegason et fratrem matris de sanguine natos / addidit et longi non falsa pericula cursus, / quae freta, quas terras sub se vidisset ab alto / et quae iactatis tetigisset sidera pennis.
source.text_english: Yet he had seen the form of Medusa in the bronze reflected from the terrible shield which his left hand bore, and while deep sleep held the snakes and her too, he had cut the head from her neck; and he added Pegasus, swift on his wings, and his brother born from his mother’s blood, and the not-false dangers of his long journey, the seas and lands he had seen beneath him from the height, and the stars he had touched with his fluttering wings.
